talents.name: Concussion

ranks.description: Increases the damage done by your Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, and Earth Shock spells by 1%.

talents.iconHint: Jagged mountain silhouette on orange/yellow; green border
talents.diffNotes: Classic hit all Shocks (+1%/rank); Forever only Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, and Earth Shock.

talents.name: Convection

ranks.description: Reduces the mana cost of your Shock, Lightning Bolt, Lava Burst, and Chain Lightning spells by 2%.

talents.iconHint: Purple/white glowing orb; green border
talents.diffNotes: Forever adds Lava Burst to mana-cost reduction list (Classic: Shock, LB, CL only).

talents.name: Call of Flame

ranks.description: Increases the damage done by your Fire Totems and by your Flame Shock, Fire Nova, and Lava Burst spells by 5%.

talents.iconHint: Volcanic mountain peaks with erupting fire; green border; arrow to Lava Burst
talents.diffNotes: Classic was Fire Totems only (+5%/rank); Forever also buffs Flame Shock, Fire Nova, and Lava Burst.

talents.name: Lava Burst

ranks.description: You hurl molten lava at the target, dealing 158 to 187 Fire damage. If your Flame Shock is on the target, Lava Burst deals 20% increased damage.

talents.iconHint: Molten lava / dark orange-red icon; receives arrow from Call of Flame
talents.diffNotes: New active talent; not in Classic 1.12 shaman tree.

talents.name: Lightning Overload

ranks.description: Gives your Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning spells a 3% chance to cast a second, similar spell on the same target at no additional cost that causes half damage and no threat.

talents.iconHint: Lightning bolt striking circular target; mid col1 chain
talents.diffNotes: New talent; not in Classic 1.12.

talents.name: Earthbound

ranks.description: Your Earthbind Totem immobilizes nearby targets for 5 sec when cast.

talents.iconHint: Earthbind totem / dust swirl; near Elemental/Enhancement divider
talents.diffNotes: New talent; not in Classic 1.12. Slot: bottom of col1 arrow chain.

talents.name: Elemental Devastation

ranks.description: Your offensive spell critical strikes will increase your chance to get a critical strike with melee attacks by 3% for 10 sec.

talents.iconHint: Humanoid silhouette near Enhancement border
talents.diffNotes: Matches Classic Elemental Devastation rank1 (+3% melee crit for 10 sec) and maxRank 3.

talents.name: Reverberation

ranks.description: Reduces the cooldown of your Shock spells by 0.2 sec.

talents.iconHint: Purple/white orb with radiating X starburst
talents.diffNotes: Matches Classic Reverberation rank1 (-0.2 sec) and maxRank 5.

talents.name: Elemental Warding

ranks.description: Reduces damage taken from Fire, Frost, and Nature effects by 3%.

talents.iconHint: Circular elemental shield emblem; row1 col0
talents.diffNotes: Classic rank1 was 4% (then 7%/10%); Forever is 3% per rank.

talents.name: Elemental Focus

ranks.description: Gives you a 10% chance to enter a Clearcasting state after casting any Fire, Frost, or Nature damage spell.  The Clearcasting state reduces the mana cost of your next damage spell by 100%.

talents.iconHint: Bright white/blue sphere or Clearcasting-style orb
talents.diffNotes: Matches Classic Elemental Focus Clearcasting text and maxRank 1.

talents.name: Elemental Fury

ranks.description: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Searing and Magma Totems and your Fire, Frost, and Nature spells by 20%.

talents.iconHint: Mountain silhouette on yellow/orange (Classic Fury icon family)
talents.diffNotes: Classic was maxRank 1 at +100% crit damage; Forever is 5 ranks at +20% per rank.

talents.name: Eye of the Storm

ranks.description: Reduces the pushback suffered from damaging attacks while casting Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, and Lava Burst by 23%.

talents.iconHint: Storm/eye style icon in mid-lower Elemental
talents.diffNotes: Classic covered LB/CL/Fire Nova/Healing Wave; Forever lists LB, CL, and Lava Burst at 23%/rank.

talents.name: Improved Fire Nova

ranks.description: Increases the damage done by your Fire Nova spell by 10% and reduces its cooldown by 2 sec.

talents.iconHint: Fiery explosion pattern
talents.diffNotes: Replaces Classic Improved Fire Totems. Forever is Fire Nova damage + CD; name changed.

talents.name: Elemental Reach

ranks.description: Increases the range of your Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, Fire Nova, and Lava Burst spells by 3 yards, and increases the range of your Flame Shock spell by 8 yards.

talents.iconHint: Hand reaching upward / energy burst
talents.diffNotes: Renamed from Classic Storm Reach; Forever adds Fire Nova/Lava Burst/Flame Shock range.

talents.name: Call of Thunder

ranks.description: Increases the critical strike chance of your Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning spells by 3%.

talents.iconHint: Hand grasping lightning bolt
talents.diffNotes: Classic was maxRank 5 at +1% crit/rank; Forever is a single rank at +3%.

talents.name: Elemental Alacrity

ranks.description: Reduces the cast time of your Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, and Lava Burst spells by 0.17 sec.

talents.iconHint: Stylized face/head with swirling energy; below Lightning Overload
talents.diffNotes: New talent; not in Classic 1.12.

talents.name: Rage of the Farseer

ranks.description: Increases your melee attack speed and spell casting speed by 30% for 25 sec.

talents.iconHint: Mask/face with glowing eyes; Enhancement capstone
talents.diffNotes: New active talent; not in Classic 1.12.

talents.name: Improved Stormstrike

ranks.description: When you Stormstrike, you have a 50% chance to gain 50% mana regeneration while casting spells for 15 sec, and Stormstrike's cooldown has a 50% chance to reset each time you Dodge or Parry.

talents.iconHint: Maces with blue lightning / armored gauntlet
talents.diffNotes: New talent; not in Classic 1.12.

talents.name: Maelstrom Weapon

ranks.description: When you deal damage with a melee attack, you have a chance to reduce the cast time and Mana cost of your next Lightning Bolt spell by 4%. Stacks up to 5 times. Lasts 30 sec.

talents.iconHint: Swirling grey/blue vortex
talents.diffNotes: New talent; not in Classic 1.12.

talents.name: Spirit Weapons

ranks.description: Gives a chance to parry enemy melee attacks, reduces all threat generated by your attacks by 30% while Rockbiter Weapon is not active, and increases all threat generated by 30% while Rockbiter Weapon is active.

talents.iconHint: Crossed swords/axes (Parry-style)
talents.diffNotes: New talent combining parry + Rockbiter threat swing; Classic Parry was separate.

talents.name: Toughness

ranks.description: Increases your Stamina by 2%.

talents.iconHint: Metallic shield or clenched armored fist
talents.diffNotes: Classic Toughness increased armor by 2%/rank; Forever increases Stamina by 2%/rank.

talents.name: Guardian Totems

ranks.description: Increases the amount of damage reduced by your Stoneskin Totem and Windwall Totem by 10% and reduces the cooldown of your Grounding Totem by 1 sec.

talents.iconHint: Orange/brown totem on green; green border tier-1
talents.diffNotes: Matches Classic Guardian Totems rank1 text and maxRank 2.

talents.name: Improved Ghost Wolf

ranks.description: Reduces the cast time of your Ghost Wolf spell by 1.0 sec, and Ghost Wolf may be used indoors.

talents.iconHint: White wolf head profile
talents.diffNotes: Classic was cast-time only; Forever also allows Ghost Wolf indoors.

talents.name: Stormstrike

ranks.description: Instantly strike for normal weapon damage and increase Nature damage you deal to the target by 20% for 12 sec.

talents.iconHint: Crossed weapons with lightning
talents.diffNotes: Values/text differ from Classic Stormstrike.

talents.name: Mental Dexterity

ranks.description: Increases your Attack Power by an amount equal to 33% of your Intellect.

talents.iconHint: Head/brain or scroll-like Intellect icon
talents.diffNotes: New talent; not in Classic 1.12.

talents.name: Improved Lightning Shield

ranks.description: Increases the damage done by your Lightning Shield orbs by 5%.

talents.iconHint: Three blue lightning orbs
talents.diffNotes: Matches Classic Improved Lightning Shield rank1 (+5%) and maxRank 3.

talents.name: Anticipation

ranks.description: Increases your chance to dodge by an additional 2%.

talents.iconHint: Grey/white helmet or face; green border tier-1 right
talents.diffNotes: Classic was maxRank 5 at +1% dodge/rank; Forever is 3 ranks at +2%/rank.

talents.name: Shamanistic Focus

ranks.description: Reduces the mana cost of your Shock and Lightning Shield spells by 45%.

talents.iconHint: Metallic mask/helmet or scroll; green border tier-1 center
talents.diffNotes: New talent; not in Classic 1.12.

talents.name: Elemental Weapons

ranks.description: Increases the melee attack power bonus of your Rockbiter Weapon by 7%, your Windfury Weapon effect by 13% and increases the damage caused by your Flametongue Weapon and Frostbrand Weapon by 5%.

talents.iconHint: Fist engulfed in orange/yellow flames
talents.diffNotes: Matches Classic Elemental Weapons rank1 percentages and maxRank 3.

talents.name: Flurry

ranks.description: Increases your attack speed by 5% for your next 3 swings after dealing a melee critical strike.

talents.iconHint: Three white claw/slash marks
talents.diffNotes: Classic rank1 was +10% attack speed; Forever rank1 is +5%.

talents.name: Mental Quickness

ranks.description: Increases your spell damage and healing by up to 15% of your Intellect.

talents.iconHint: Brain with lightning or metallic gauntlet
talents.diffNotes: New talent; not in Classic 1.12.

talents.name: Improved Healing Wave

ranks.description: Reduces the casting time of your Healing Wave spell by 0.1 sec.

talents.iconHint: Green glowing hand; green border
talents.diffNotes: Matches Classic Improved Healing Wave rank1 (-0.1 sec) and maxRank 5.

talents.name: Tidal Mastery

ranks.description: Increases the critical effect chance of your healing spells by 1%.

talents.iconHint: Swirling white/light-blue water/clouds (also claimed row0 in 58.png)
talents.diffNotes: Classic also buffed lightning spell crit; Forever is healing spells only.

talents.name: Mindfulness

ranks.description: Allows 17% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.

talents.iconHint: Head silhouette with glowing center
talents.diffNotes: New talent; not in Classic 1.12.

talents.name: Natural Grace

ranks.description: Reduces the threat generated by your spells by 5%.

talents.iconHint: Green glowing hand / leaf
talents.diffNotes: Renamed from Classic Healing Grace; Forever reduces threat from spells.

talents.name: Tidal Focus

ranks.description: Reduces the Mana cost of your healing spells by 1% and increases your chance to hit with all spells and attacks by 1%.

talents.iconHint: Blue/grey cloudy sky next to Improved Healing Wave; green border
talents.diffNotes: Classic was mana cost only (-1%/rank); Forever also grants +1% hit per rank.

talents.name: Improved Reincarnation

ranks.description: Reduces the cooldown of your Reincarnation spell by 10 min. Increases your maximum health by 2%, and increases the amount of health and Mana you reincarnate with by an additional 10%.

talents.iconHint: Stylized figure/ankh
talents.diffNotes: Forever adds +2% maximum health; Classic was CD + reincarnate HP/mana only.

talents.name: Ancestral Healing

ranks.description: Increases your target's armor value by 8% for 15 sec after getting a critical effect from one of your healing spells.

talents.iconHint: Spectral figure / energy burst
talents.diffNotes: Matches Classic Ancestral Healing rank1 (+8% armor 15 sec) and maxRank 3.

talents.name: Healing Focus

ranks.description: Gives you a 23% chance to avoid interruption caused by damage while casting any healing spell.

talents.iconHint: Green-glowing staff or beam
talents.diffNotes: Classic was maxRank 5 at 14%/rank; Forever is 3 ranks at 23%/rank.

talents.name: Water Shield

ranks.description: The caster is surrounded by 3 globes of water. When a spell, melee, or ranged attack hits the caster or when one of the caster's healing spells gets a critical result, 2% of maximum mana is restored to the caster, expending one water globe. Only one globe will activate every few seconds. Lasts 10 min. Only one Elemental Shield can be active on the Shaman at any one time.

talents.iconHint: Blue circular shield with water energy
talents.diffNotes: New talent; not in Classic 1.12.

talents.name: Mana Tide Totem

ranks.description: Summons a Mana Tide Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 12 sec that restores 88 mana every 3 seconds to group members within 30 yards.

talents.iconHint: Totem with wispy white/blue energy
talents.diffNotes: Numbers/range differ from Classic Mana Tide Totem.

talents.name: Restorative Totems

ranks.description: Increases the effect of your Mana Spring Totem by 5% and increases the effect of your Healing Stream Totem by 10%.

talents.iconHint: Multiple totems with blue/white energy / vial
talents.diffNotes: Classic Healing Stream was +5%/rank; Forever Healing Stream is +10%/rank.

talents.name: Totemic Focus

ranks.description: Reduces the Mana cost of your totems and any spells that summon or move them by 5%.

talents.iconHint: Totem base icon
talents.diffNotes: Classic was totem mana cost only; Forever also covers spells that summon or move totems.

talents.name: Healing Way

ranks.description: Increases the amount healed by your Healing Wave spell by 8%.

talents.iconHint: Hand reaching upward with soft glow
talents.diffNotes: Classic was a stacking HW proc buff; Forever is a flat +8% Healing Wave per rank.

talents.name: Nature's Swiftness

ranks.description: When activated, your next Nature spell with a casting time less than 10 sec. becomes an instant cast spell.

talents.iconHint: Silver-white leaf or wing
talents.diffNotes: Matches Classic Nature's Swiftness text and maxRank 1.

talents.name: Purification

ranks.description: Increases the effectiveness of your healing spells by 2%.

talents.iconHint: Hand radiating white/yellow light
talents.diffNotes: Matches Classic Purification rank1 (+2%) and maxRank 5.

talents.name: Riptide

ranks.description: Heals a friendly target for 479 to 528, an additional 499 over 15 sec, and increases the effectiveness of your Chain Heal casts directly on that target by 25%.

talents.iconHint: Metallic gauntlet / glowing totem base; bottom of column
talents.diffNotes: New active talent; not in Classic 1.12.
